editorial.blurb: A tiny Bridgeport gem where fresh-made Chinese-American comfort food—from crispy salt & pepper chicken to Italian beef-inspired sandwiches—punches way above its modest space.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for dine-in to keep the crispy textures intact; order the 3LP Fried Rice instead of the standard lo mein, and ask the sweet staff to cut your sandwich if you'd like.
